summary.intent: Evaluate how to improve the wisp-plugins (ranger, smith, sentinel, scribe, etc.) based on learnings from Entire's review/slop agents, using the Caliper 'road-to-v1-alpha' and Callisto sessions as evidence.
summary.outcome: Three research lanes were dispatched and synthesized into docs/evaluations/review-slop-learnings/README.md in a worktree (branch worktree-review-slop-evaluation). It was staged and `just check` passed, but the commit was blocked by gpg sandbox failure; a retry outside the sandbox was being attempted and the push was denied. No plugin changes were made.

repo: wisp-plugins has no agent or skill that owns slop review of workspace code (filler, dead code, duplicated helpers, fabricated APIs, overclaimed docs); smith:reviewer covers scope/verification/siblings and ranger hunts reachable defects only.
Nothing checks README/changelog/docs claims against code; scribe:spec-drift only compares specs to code, and check-versions.sh/check-skills-doc.sh only check version and skill-dir consistency.
No judge-style consolidation of multiple reviewer reports exists; sentinel gates, courier:receive-feedback, mason adjudicator and vanguard:synthesizer each handle a different artifact.
Each agent embeds a byte-identical copy of the constitution (shared/constitution.md); ADRs 001-010 are in docs/adr/, while ADR 011/012 exist only in the frontend-design-evaluation worktree.
The constitution's API Grounding Invariant covers specs and plans but not implementer briefs or worker prompts.
tests/test_reference_integrity.py fails when docs mention a nonexistent path (e.g. a proposed slop.md), so proposals must not be written as file paths.
verdict@3 and implementation-result@1 schemas already require evidence fields (criteria_evidence, verified_scope, coverage_gaps), so evidence-based gating can be extended without schema changes.
Caliper had Entire reviewer findings (22 across 7 runs); Callisto has no Entire review profile, and no 'Callisto alpha' session exists (only Caliper's Road to v1 Alpha).

code.finding: Returns implementation-review@2; names search theater/test theater as failure modes but has no slop-detection checklist and loads comments.md only when the diff touches comments.
API Grounding Invariant (approx. line 64) is the rule to extend to briefs and worker prompts.
Must read the exact file and line of each criteria_evidence pointer and confirm it proves the criterion.
Must populate criteria_evidence when status is done.

workflow: Subagent reports are model output, not verified fact; the Caliper lane itself flagged that sweep claims were unverified and only 3 of 88 changes had findings fetched.
Entire findings can be stale (4 already-fixed findings still shown as current); reproduce findings on current main before treating them as real.

Recurring failure patterns across both projects: hand-copied lists that drift, string keys across boundaries, failure treated as absence, harness differing from real consumer, stub-fed tests that cannot fail, 'merged and green' reported as done, docs written from intent.
`entire checkpoint explain` can't resolve Codex session ids; Codex sessions live in ~/.codex/sessions/*.jsonl.zst and Claude transcripts in ~/.claude/projects/.
Sandbox blocks writes to ~/.local/share/entire (Brain lock file) and ~/.gnupg (gpg signing), and Entire search needed an outside-sandbox retry due to TLS trust failure.

Adopted process fixes from the source projects: refute-first and failing-test-first worker briefs, self-review before reporting, fresh-context audit passes, real-binary contract tests, registry tests that fail instead of skip in CI.

friction: Initial request was ambiguous; the learnings could not be found in Entire history until the user named the road-to sessions.
Brain brief failed because the sandbox blocks its lock file under ~/.local/share/entire.
Entire search hit a TLS trust failure in the sandbox and had to be retried outside it.
Commit signing failed because the sandbox blocked gpg from ~/.gnupg; the user was frustrated, believing their SSH key setup was at fault.
Pushing the branch was denied by the permission classifier.
Initial draft mentioned a nonexistent slop.md path and broke the reference-integrity test.
Entire retrieval limits: checkpoint explain returned nothing usable, `entire review --findings` showed no local runs, and the incident file was not on disk.
open_items: Commit the staged evaluation (retry outside sandbox) and push the branch if desired.
Decide whether to extend the constitution's API Grounding Invariant to briefs and worker prompts.
Decide whether to add a judge-style consolidation step for multiple reviewer reports, which needs a new schema.
Decide whether plugins may depend on the entire CLI.

Implement the first batch: failure-as-absence and projection-as-authority hazards in the ranger pack; smith reviewer/mutator rejecting tests that cannot fail; sentinel and smith exit-gate requiring externally observed outcomes; a slop-review reference pack loaded by smith:reviewer.
Add docs-versus-code claim checking, likely in scribe.
Fetch Entire findings for the remaining 85 Caliper changes and read the Callisto transcripts more fully to validate that patterns generalize beyond two projects by one author.
